'''''Ranunculus bullatus''''', commonly known as '''autumn buttercup''',<ref>{{cite web|title=Ranunculus bullatus - Autumn Buttercup|url=http://www.eimagesite.org/s3/gst/run.cgi?page=s3_plantae_R_Ranunculus_bullatus|website=eimagesite.org|publisher=eimage|accessdate=19 November 2016}}</ref>  is a [[Perennial plant|perennial]] member of the [[Ranunculus|buttercup]] family [[Ranunculaceae]], native to [[Europe]] and [[north Africa]], including most [[List of islands in the Mediterranean|Mediterranean islands]].

==Description==
[[File:Ranunculus bullatus (4386830975).jpg|thumb|left|Oval, toothed leaves]]
Its leaves, which only grow at the base of the stem, are 2–6 cm long, oval, and have broad rounded teeth. Each plant has 1 or 2 flowers which are yellow, scented and about 25mm in diameter. Each has 5-12 petals which are slightly irregular.<ref>{{cite book|last1=Polunin|first1=Oleg|authorlink = Oleg Polunin|title=Flowers of South-west Europe: A Field Guide|date=1988|publisher=Oxford University Press|isbn=978-0192881786|page=190}}</ref> It flowers from October to December, often covering large areas of ground.<ref>{{cite book|last1=Blamey|first1=Marjorie|title=Flores silvestres del Mediterráneo|date=2008|publisher=Barcelona:Omega|isbn= 978-84-282-1450-6}}</ref>

==Distribution and habitat==
Grows throughout the Mediterranean region, including north Africa, in rocky places, olive groves and dry fields, from sea-level up to 900m.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ranunculus bullatus|url=http://www.cretanflora.com/ranunculus_bullatus.html|website=cretanflora.com|publisher=Cretan Flora|accessdate=23 November 2016}}</ref>

==Etymology==
In [[Latin]] ''Rānunculus'' means "little frog", from ''rāna'' "frog", and ''bullatus'' means "inflated".<ref>[http://www.winternet.com/~chuckg/dictionary/dictionary.50.html Dictionary of Botanical Epithets]</ref>

==Subspecies==
There are three [[subspecies]], ''Ranunculus bullatus subsp. bullatus'' (L.)<ref>{{cite web|title=Ranunculus bullatus L.|url=http://www.tela-botanica.org/page:eflore_bdtfx?referentiel=bdtfx&niveau=2&module=fiche&action=fiche&num_nom=54863&onglet=synthese|website=tela-botanica.org|publisher=Tela-botanica|accessdate=23 November 2016}}</ref> which grows in the [[Iberian Peninsula]], France and Italy; ''Ranunculus bullatus subsp. cytheraeus'' (Halácsy)<ref>{{cite web|title=Ranunculus bullatus subsp. cytheraeus (Halácsy) Vierh|url=http://www.catalogueoflife.org/col/details/species/id/798f80134a6b6df49bbc8313d03fe469/synonym/e4e2433fdc042d0b6cf2a7428ab25852|website=catalogueoflife.org|publisher=Catalogue of Life|accessdate=23 November 2016}}</ref> which grows in the [[eastern Mediterranean]] including [[Libya]]; and ''Ranunculus bullatus subsp. supranudus'' (Jordan & Fourr.)
<ref>{{cite web|title=Ranunculus bullatus subsp. supranudus|url=http://www.catalogueoflife.org/col/details/species/id/c2137c8be6d73efc6d9cdb5e2266cdf5/synonym/0a02d8e3e5ba305b6e35ea30df322c7b|website=catalogueoflife.org|publisher=Catalogue of life|accessdate=28 November 2016}}</ref> which grows in Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia.
